allow: PowerShell($pids = @\(504,14192,15728,24676,26536,27516,28088,35424,41300,42124,50956,53532\); foreach \($p in $pids\) { try { $proc = Get-Process -Id $p -ErrorAction Stop; "$p`t$\($proc.ProcessName\)" } catch { "$p`tNOT_FOUND" } })

PowerShell($pids = @\(504,14192,15728,24676,26536,27516,28088,35424,41300,42124,50956,53532\); Get-CimInstance Win32_Process -Filter \($pids | ForEach-Object { "ProcessId=$_" }\) -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object ProcessId, @{N='Cmd';E={$_.CommandLine.Substring\(0,[Math]::Min\(120,$_.CommandLine.Length\)\)}} | Format-Table -AutoSize -Wrap)

PowerShell($ids = @\(504,14192,15728,24676,26536,27516,28088,35424,41300,42124,50956,53532\); foreach \($id in $ids\) { $p = Get-CimInstance Win32_Process -Filter "ProcessId=$id" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if \($p\) { $cmd = $p.CommandLine; if \($cmd.Length -gt 140\) { $cmd = $cmd.Substring\(0,140\) }; "$id | $cmd" } })

PowerShell($ids = @\(504,14192,15728,24676,26536,27516,28088,35424,41300,42124,50956,53532\); foreach \($id in $ids\) { try { Stop-Process -Id $id -Force -ErrorAction Stop; "killed $id" } catch { "skip $id \($\($_.Exception.Message\)\)" } })

PowerShell($ids = @\(10968,50732,34708,30816,33024,3392\); foreach \($id in $ids\) { $p = Get-CimInstance Win32_Process -Filter "ProcessId=$id" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if \($p\) { $cmd = $p.CommandLine; if \($cmd.Length -gt 130\) { $cmd = $cmd.Substring\(0,130\) }; "$id | $cmd" } })
